body:
## Maintainer request — 2026-10-09

> With my approval to push this change and commit it for our next branch. Also, we should remove community from our build because, now that we're our own hard fork and our own distro, we don't need to have a community build. We should instead try to include our semver number, and then add a date and potentially a time or a hash, or however we want to best represent when we might have multiple builds per day. Align this with what we're doing on GitHub as well.

## Existing behavior

`OS_VERSION` is0.0.1, while scripts/image overwrites DISTRO_VERSION with a date and assigns OS_BUILD=community through an encoded shell block. INFORMATION and SSH banners append that category. It also enables fresh-install network/logging defaults in the rocknix package. Development filenames omit the timestamp/hash and can collide. The old release helper discovers ROCKNIX-prefixed assets by date and can overwrite assets/undraft releases. #265 already owns overall versioned publication; this child owns the requested identity implementation.

## Implementation scope

Use semantic release versions (0.0.1-dev, 0.0.1-rc.N, 0.0.1), plus UTC build timestamp and source hash as build metadata. Keep the full BUILD_ID for provenance. Align device information, filenames, metadata and planned GitHub tags/titles without renaming historical assets or publishing an unqualified release. Preserve existing network/logging defaults independently of the removed community label. Retain the from-ROCKNIX adoption suffix and existing storage contracts.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Host controls cover identity derivation, same-day collisions, publication selection and malformed inputs; a disposable guest can exercise the actual information script/ES screen at640x480 with source-bound frames. No physical fact or owner device operation is required. Full installed/upgrade qualification belongs to the next assembled candidate, together with #529.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Recorded policy and executable derivation produce distinct same-day identities and consistent semantic versions/timestamp/hash/GitHub naming; retained control output proves it.
- [x] Image assembly, banners and information script use the new identity; actual package staging proves fresh-install defaults are unchanged. Exact-source information frames and canonical flow reference record the display change.
- [x] Release preparation uses an explicit immutable bundle, validates identity and checksums, and returns the matching GitHub tag/title and exact assets without publishing or overwriting anything. Wrong/stale inputs fail in retained controls. Actual publication remains #265/#528.
- [ ] Next assembled candidate verifies installed identity and filenames, clean and retained-storage behavior, and source-bound information frames. Runtime-overlay proof alone does not tick this criterion.

Already written: existing0.0.1/community firmware and historical GitHub tags remain historical. This change does not rewrite stored settings, cloud selections or retained archives. No public RC/release designation is conferred by a version string.

## Maintainer scope refinement — 2026-10-09

> We should then create an issue to detach the reliance on that community tag and instead align it with our naming strategy for how we may want to handle alpha, beta, release candidate, and stable builds. Have other build process and how we do this in terms of the progression.
>
> Right now, we are taking more of a rolling release approach, so it's not imperative that we go into that level of detail in terms of how we structure our builds. We do need to make sure that it's detached from this concept of a community build, which is no longer something that matters for us with pixelelated and how we're constructing our new OS.

> You can begin work on 530 as well.

Current work is the community decoupling and rolling build identity. Qualifier syntax supports future alpha/beta/RC/stable names, but no promotion pipeline or mandatory progression is introduced. #265 owns defining that later progression. A local release plan is preparation only; #528 and the existing publication gates still apply.

## Verified source implementation — 2026-10-09

29 host controls and exact runtime INFORMATION script/frames pass at640x480; existing settings hashes are unchanged. Actual image naming/metadata emission and package post_install hooks were executed in disposable staging. Original failed harness evidence is retained; corrected owner02 passes. All owner processes exited and the VM disk/keys were retired. Evidence: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-09-build-identity/`. This is source/overlay qualification, not new firmware. The remaining assembled-candidate criterion stays open alongside #529.

The pre-existing USB gadget calendar-version parser surfaced during source tracing and is tracked separately as #531 before the next candidate. Source integration/check receipts will be in `/tmp/pix530-final-readback.json`. No release or handheld action occurred.
title: M7.P5: Replace community build labels with semantic build identity
